# `mise bootstrap settings apply`

- **Usage:** `mise bootstrap settings apply [-n --dry-run] [PLUGIN]…`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/bootstrap.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap.rs)

Write the settings that differ from `[bootstrap.settings]`

It does not ask for confirmation.

## Arguments
- **`[PLUGIN]…`** — Plugins whose sections to apply; all of them by default

## Flags
- **`-n --dry-run`** — Show which settings would change without changing them
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
